title: Vials you can tune, saved FX, colored keys
thisBuild: Cut works like every other vial now: empty is off, full is the most filtering. An empty Cut no longer silences a pad.
Tap a vial's name for that effect's settings, right over the vials: how much, reverb's Space, echo's time, its Auto lane, and the sound's own FX.
Auto lanes draw right over the vials (Auto on the FX drawer, or hold a vial's lamp, Cut and Res too). No more jumping to the Seq tab.
Load and Save on the FX drawer: Wash, Grit, Tape, Space and Dry come with the app; Save keeps your own set for any pad.
Keys that open things wear their color (pages purple, Edit and Pack pink, FX, LFO and XY teal); switches stay dark. The FannyPack's add menu matches.
Bigger keys on wide screens, and Settings, Look, Large keys makes every key about a quarter bigger.

Lag work, round two: keys are drawn once and reused, the buffer can only grow 3 steps after clicks (Settings, Playing, Buffer: steady lets it grow more), and the BPM readout shows clicks this minute in red.
watch: Play for five minutes: does a red click count ever show beside the lag?
Tap a vial name, change reverb's Space: can you hear it now?
Colored caps: keep them, or too much?
limits: The scratch synth still plays straight to the speaker; the next build puts it on its own hidden pad.
The sound is still on Android's older audio path; moving it to AAudio is two builds away.
Your saved FX live on the phone, not in the mess.
